effective_overrides.old: raw negative-control rejections remain reported and count toward CAL-01
effective_overrides.new: raw negative-control rejections are fully reported as diagnostics but do not enter CAL-01; negative controls can never become candidate signals

clarification.CAL-01: FWER is the probability that at least one of the ten primary candidate decisions is falsely rejected under a complete null world; the exact historical Holm family is reused
clarification.CAL-04: negative-control candidate promotions must equal zero by an executed classification guard; raw negative-control p-values and rejection frequencies are reported separately

root_cause: the base note contradicted the CAL-01 definition and would either force an approximately ten-percent raw-control union error or silently change the historical ten-primary Holm family
change_control: no formal historical statistic or D2-07/D2-08/D2-09 existed when this amendment was frozen; all downstream identities must include both base contract and P2-A01
